title: Helen Possible NDE 9200
content: 1. I was under general anesthesia for a dental operation and was sitting in a dental chair with my back to the door. I saw my mother looking into a room that was next to the one where I was sitting. She asked, 'So, is it over?' After I woke up, I asked my mother if this had happened. She confirmed that it had happened. 2. The second experience was also during anesthesia. I saw a brightly-lit room and people were standing over a table. I heard a loud, resounding voice that told me, 'Just don't forget to breathe!' This roused me from the dream and I woke up. I asked the doctors who had said this and it turned out that nobody had said it or heard anyone say it. And no one had been standing over me. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1985 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Surgery-related While under general anesthesia How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Uncertain. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. The light was brighter than normal. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When the vision took place Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. I did not perceive time Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. the same Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. a loud voice Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, but the facts have not been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes there was a very bright light throughout the room Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. The room had a white light What emotions did you feel during the experience? calm Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Jehovahs Witness What is your religion now? Christian- Jehovahs Witness Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. Like many people of a young age, I was not certain whether there was something THERE. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes It became clear that we don’t know everything about ourselves. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes The voice that I heard was not like anything I had ever heard before. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. I understood that earthly life is not the most essential thing Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. The experience was vivid, distinct, and retained in my memory. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I talk about it occasionally Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes Did the questions asked and information that you provided accurately and comprehensively describe your experience? Uncertain

environment.environment_other_detail: A brightly-lit room / a room with white light; described as unfamiliar and strange.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Roused/woke up from anesthesia after hearing a loud voice ('Just don't forget to breathe!').

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Dental operation under general anesthesia (two experiences during anesthesia).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two anesthesia-related visions: (1) saw mother outside/adjacent room and later verified; (2) saw brightly lit room with people over a table and heard a loud voice: 'Just don't forget to breathe!'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel; experiences described as visions during anesthesia with bright light/room imagery and a loud voice; waking followed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred under general anesthesia for dental operation; included a veridical-seeming observation of mother asking, 'So, is it over?' later confirmed. Second episode included a loud, resounding voice saying, 'Just don't forget to breathe!' and a vision of a brightly lit room with people over a table, which staff denied.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Mother: 'So, is it over?' Voice: 'Just don't forget to breathe!'
